info.title: Rise Above Foundation Cebu API
info.description: Interactive REST API reference for the Donation and Relief Management System. Authenticate with `POST /api/login.php`, copy the returned `token`, select **Authorize**, and enter the token. Role restrictions shown on each operation are enforced by the existing backend.

servers.description: Local Vite proxy (forwards /api to PHP on port 8000)
